# ?buy from ASSS 1.4.4 src/core/buy.c (compiled unmodified).
# '# <label>:' sets the arena's [Cost] section; every Cost key not listed is 0.
#   try [<params>] <ship|spec> <in safe zone 0/1> <STAT_KILL_POINTS> <STAT_FLAG_POINTS>
#   prize <type> <count>   what Igame::GivePrize was called with, or '- -' for no call
#   stat <kill points> <flag points>   the player's stats afterwards
#   chat <text>            each chat line, in order
# Rules these records pin:
#   Item lookup is strstr over the table IN TABLE ORDER with no break, so the LAST
#     entry whose string occurs anywhere in the parameters wins, not the best or the
#     first match. 'thorax' buys Thor (thor is later in the table than x), 'exit'
#     buys XRadar, 'report' buys Portal, 'superbrick' buys Brick, 'antithrust' buys
#     AntiWarp. The test is case-SENSITIVE, so 'Bomb' matches nothing at all.
#   The checks run in this order, and each one returns: unknown item, then cost == 0,
#     then spectator, then safe zone, then affordability. A spectator naming an item
#     that is not for sale is told the item is not for sale, not that they are in spec.
#   A cost of 0 means 'not for sale' -- there is no free item.
#   Affordability is STAT_KILL_POINTS + STAT_FLAG_POINTS at INTERVAL_RESET, and the
#     test is 'pts < cost', so paying exactly all your points succeeds.
#   The price is deducted from FLAG points alone, to leave the kill average intact.
#     Flag points therefore go negative whenever the kill points carried the purchase.
#   The prize type is the VIE prize number from the table, not the item's index, and
#     the count is always 1.
#   ?buy with no parameters lists only items whose cost is non-zero, in table order,
#     formatted 'buy: %-9s %6d'; with none on sale it says so instead.
# The item table, in the order buy.c declares it (index, parameter string, setting,
# prize type):
item 0 x XRadar 6
item 1 recharge Recharge 1
item 2 energy Energy 2
item 3 rot Rotation 3
item 4 stealth Stealth 4
item 5 cloak Cloak 5
item 6 gun Gun 8
item 7 bomb Bomb 9
item 8 bounce Bounce 10
item 9 thrust Thrust 11
item 10 speed Speed 12
item 11 multi MultiFire 15
item 12 prox Prox 16
item 13 super Super 17
item 14 shield Shield 18
item 15 shrap Shrap 19
item 16 anti AntiWarp 20
item 17 rep Repel 21
item 18 burst Burst 22
item 19 decoy Decoy 23
item 20 thor Thor 24
item 21 brick Brick 26
item 22 rocket Rocket 27
item 23 port Portal 28
# nothing on sale: PurchaseAnytime 0
try [] ship 1 1000 1000
prize - -
stat 1000 1000
chat There are no items available to purchase in this arena.
try [thor] ship 1 1000 1000
prize - -
stat 1000 1000
chat That item isn't available for purchase.
# a few items on sale: PurchaseAnytime 0 XRadar=100 Rotation=250 Thor=5000 Portal=75
try [] ship 1 1000 1000
prize - -
stat 1000 1000
chat buy: XRadar       100
chat buy: Rotation     250
chat buy: Thor        5000
chat buy: Portal        75
try [] spec 0 0 0
prize - -
stat 0 0
chat buy: XRadar       100
chat buy: Rotation     250
chat buy: Thor        5000
chat buy: Portal        75
